name: Silent Classroom ASL VR
summary: The Silent Classroom is a VR serious game designed to enhance ASL learning through immersive interaction. Set in a virtual ASL classroom, players engage with hand-tracking technology to sign alphabets, reinforcing their finger spelling skills in a fun and educational way. The game introduces a storytelling element, guiding players through the history of ASL and figures like Irving King Jordan, making learning more meaningful.
